roadmap.goal: Every lookup of an issue-level resource is keyed by the resolved id of its authorised parent (RCA RC-1/RC-2/RC-3). Board move, issue edit and edit pre-fill find the issue by (resolved project_id, number), never by key_prefix across workspaces (Defect 1). An attachment download serves only an attachment of the issue in the URL (Defect 2). Viewing, editing and deleting a comment only reach a comment of the issue in the URL (sweep sibling). A check-arch rule keeps every foundry-store key_prefix or slug lookup scoped by workspace_id, team_id or project_id, and two-tenant fixtures use colliding natural keys.
roadmap.scenario_ownership_invariant: Each RCA section 6 regression test is owned by exactly one step: 01-01 owns T1-T3 (write_use_cases.rs) and T4 (update_issue_details.rs, reposition_issue.rs; the tenant-isolation test re-seeded with a colliding prefix); 01-02 owns T5-T8 (attachment_scoping.rs, new) and T10 (us-11); 01-03 owns T9 and the comment read rows (comment_scoping.rs, new); 01-04 owns the comment mutation rows (comment_scoping.rs), the admin-moderation controls and the API PATCH row (api_comment_scoping.rs, new); 01-05 owns the check-arch store-natural-key-scoped gold tests and T11 (mwt-slice-04). Every test except the positive controls and T11 is seen RED on the parent commit before GREEN; T4's compile-failure RED is backed by the SQL hand-pin. The chain 01-01 -> 01-05 is serial on purpose: the steps share foundry-store/src/lib.rs and foundry-app/src/comments.rs.

phases.name: Bind every issue-level lookup to its resolved parent (RCA fix-issue-attachment-scoping: Defects 1 and 2, comment sibling, RC-2 guard)
